title: tests/kernel/test_shash.c: in-kernel tests for SHA-2/3, HMAC, CMAC
description: Kernel module testing all nine shash registrations. For each hash (sha256, sha384, sha512, sha3-256, sha3-512): run 3 FIPS 180-4 / FIPS 202 known-answer tests including empty-string input; run a multi-update test (split input into three chunks, call update three times, verify final == single-update result). For HMAC (hmac(sha256), hmac(sha384), hmac(sha512)): run RFC 4231 test cases 1 and 2. For CMAC (cmac(aes)): run SP 800-38B example 1 and 2. Print pass/fail per vector.
design: Use crypto_alloc_shash() and SHASH_DESC_ON_STACK (or shash_desc_alloc for larger descriptors). .descsize from crypto_shash_descsize() determines alloc size. For multi-update: compute in three pieces, compare to single digest_call result (use a separate shash instance). Verify crypto_shash_driver_name() == 'wolfkm-sha256' etc. See tests/vectors/hmac.h and sha256.h.
acceptance_criteria: All 9 algorithms PASS all vectors including empty input. Multi-update sha256 matches single-update sha256. RFC 4231 HMAC vectors pass. SP 800-38B CMAC vectors pass.
